info.name: Iroad — Mobile Driver API (POD Capture)
info.description:
POD Capture + Execute bundle promotion.

**Auth:** `Bearer {{bearer_token}}` (no login).
**Tenant:** `X-Tenant-ID: {{tenant_header}}`.

See `POD_CAPTURE_SETUP.md` and `POD_CAPTURE_SAMPLE_PAYLOADS.md`.

request.description: Same `client_capture_id` as request 1 — expect **200** + `replayed: true`. Run after **1**.
No latitude/longitude when action requires GPS.

item.name: 03 — Execute promotion flow
item.description: Complete **01 → 1** first. Set `execute_pod_action_code` from Job Detail.

request.description: Set `expired_bundle_id` to an expired bundle UUID — expect **410**.
